faq: Will my content and URLs stay?
Yes. We carry your content over and keep page addresses wherever possible. Where an address has to change, we add a redirect.
Do you need a design from me?
No. We propose a direction based on your brand and examples you like. If you have design files, we build to them. We show you progress during the week.
Is this the same as a migration?
No. A redesign changes how the site looks and feels. A migration changes the technology underneath. We can do both in one project if you order each service.
Can you keep my current backend?
Often yes. If your site has a working backend or API, we build a new front end on top of it. We check this at the start and tell you if the old backend is holding things back.
desc:
Rebuilding and redesigning a website or app gives an existing product a cleaner interface and faster code without losing its content or page addresses. Ecom Swift LLC reviews what you have, agrees a design direction and builds the new version in React or Next.js.

## What does it mean to rebuild and redesign a site?

A rebuild replaces the front end of your site or app: the layout, components, styling and code that visitors see and touch. A redesign changes how it looks and feels. Done together, you get a modern interface on clean code, while your content, data and existing addresses stay in place. Your backend can usually remain as it is.

## Why an old interface holds a product back

An interface that was built years ago often struggles on phones, loads slowly and looks different from the brand you have now. Pages were added one at a time, so buttons, spacing and fonts vary from screen to screen. Every change takes longer because the code has no shared components, and fixing one page breaks another.

Visitors judge a product by its interface long before they use it. A dated look makes careful businesses appear careless, and difficult forms and menus add friction at the moments that matter.

## How a new interface affects users and growth

A consistent interface lowers effort. When buttons, forms and navigation behave the same on every page, people learn the product once. Responsive layouts make the site usable on phones, where many people arrive. Faster code lets pages appear sooner, and an accessibility check helps more people use the site.

Reusable components also change your costs. Once the library exists, new pages are assembled from tested pieces instead of built from scratch. Keeping addresses stable protects the traffic and links you already have, which is why we avoid renaming pages without a reason.

## What a great redesign includes

- A review of your current pages, content and what visitors do most.
- An agreed design direction: colors, typography, spacing and tone.
- A responsive layout that works on small phones and wide screens.
- A reusable component library for buttons, forms, cards and navigation.
- Your existing content and images carried over, with images optimized.
- Page addresses kept the same wherever possible, with redirects for any that change.
- Forms rebuilt with clear validation and helpful error states.
- An accessibility check on key pages: contrast, keyboard use and labels.
- Subtle motion on pages and menus, used with restraint.
- A live preview you can review before anything changes.

## What we do

We start by reviewing your site and agreeing the direction with you. We then build in React or Next.js, using your existing content and data, and show you a working preview. The Basic package rebuilds the home page and the core style with a mobile layout. Standard adds several key page types, a component library, image optimization and an accessibility check. Premium rebuilds more page types, forms, animation and adds automated visual and unit tests.

This is a front end rebuild. If you also need to move your data to a new platform, that is a migration, which we quote and deliver separately.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Collect your logo, brand colors and examples of sites you admire.
- List the pages that matter most to visitors and to sales.
- Review the live preview on your own phone.
- Give feedback in one organized batch per round.
- Keep your current site running until the new one is approved.

**Avoid:**
- Changing page addresses just because the design changed.
- Adding new features in the middle of a redesign.
- Letting several people send conflicting feedback.
- Choosing animation over readability.
- Skipping a mobile check before launch.

## Who this is for

This service suits a business whose site works but looks dated beside its competitors. It suits a startup whose first prototype was assembled in a hurry and now needs a consistent look. It also suits a team that wants to move an old front end to a modern framework while keeping its backend.

## What we need from you

Send the address of your current site, access to the code as a collaborator, and any brand files you have. A written design brief is welcome, but not required. We never need your passwords. After you order, we send a checklist and keep you updated until the preview is ready for review.
